一轮结束时，方框从边缘缓缓呼吸三次，之后留一层柔光等你查看；在终端里发送新指令也: When a round finishes, the card slowly breathes from its edges three times, then keeps a soft glow until you look; sending a new prompt in the terminal also counts as looking. Steady green means a finished round you have seen. Nothing repeats without a new prompt.
